name: motion-pop-scale
title: Pop Scale
description: Bong bóng thoại phóng từ rất nhỏ lên 116 % rồi về đúng cỡ, hiện rõ trong 0.12 giây đầu.

moworks.author: moworks

options.peakAt: share of the length at the peak (0.72), power2.out up, power2.inOut down
options.exitAt: s after the start to shrink to 0.6 and fade (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Speech bubble (120×56, r 16, tail lower-left) scales about its centre 0.05 → 1.16 at 374 ms (power2.out) → 1 at 520 ms (power2.inOut); opacity 0 → 1 over the first 120 ms (linear); no rotation (recipe ease: easeOutBack). Exit: shrinks to 0.6 and fades, 220 ms power2.in. Params: duration (0.52 s) · from: cỡ đầu (0.05) · peak: đỉnh (1.16) · origin (giữa).
moworks.titleVi: Bật phóng lên, vượt rồi về
